Commentary.Commentary: So, that's that from the 1st ODI then, it was a super entertainer to say the least. Australia have romped home comfortably in the end. England, will have a chance to make it even, come the 2nd ODI. That happens on Sunday, 13th September 2020 at 1300 Local (1200 GMT). Do join us for that and until then, take care!

Josh Hazlewood is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says that he really enjoyed bowling today. Hazlewood is pretty happy to have bowled with the new ball. He says that it was absolutely necessary to get it right at the very start, given the explosive opening combination of Roy and Bairstow that England possess. Feels that he is happy to play fresh after the T20Is earlier. Says that Mitchell Marsh played really well today. After the practice matches, Hazlewood states that he was dying to get on the ground for the real action.

Eoin Morgan, the English skipper, says that the game slipped away from them in the first 10-12 overs which Australia bowled to them. Feels that England had a chance despite that but in the end, full credits to Australia for the way they played today. Lauds Sam Billings for his fortitude. Morgan believes that England should have kept taking wickets earlier, when they bowled, so that they could have restricted the total. Feels for Billings on not getting opportunities earlier. On Stokes, Morgan states that Stokes' absence is a big hole in the side, with both bat and ball.

Aaron Finch, Australia's captain, says that it was nice to win and that his side started just the way he wanted them to. Says that there were some cracks early on, in the pitch and that Archer bowled really well to exploit the same. He praises the partnership between Mitchell Marsh and Glenn Maxwell and that that was key in them getting the total that they got.

What won Australia the game? It has to be stand which rescued them between Maxwell and Stoinis. They were struggling at 123 for 5 but the two joined hands and smashed a 100-plus run stand which took them close to 300. Their bowlers then did their job and the 20 overs bowled between Zampa and Hazlewood saw Billing's maiden ton go in vain.

England now might be wondering, had they not lost so many wickets quickly, the result would have been different. Also, had Bairstow just hung in there for longer, they could have well finished on the right side. That though was not the case, some rash shots, some good deliveries, some good fielding from the Aussies ensured the English were always chasing the game and in the end, they fell well short.

A comfortable win for Australia in the end! An excellent bowling performance. Hazlewood and Starc were brilliant with the new ball. Especially Hazlewood. His two wickets at the start pushed the hosts onto the back foot! Zampa then came in and continued the good work. He was probably the pick of the bowlers, with 4 wickets. There was a stand between Bairstow and Billings which did get England back in the game but the former's wicket and lack of support for Billings after that meant it was always going to be an uphill task for the centurion. It was a top knock from him but it went in vain.

OUT! CAUGHT! It goes high in the air and Billings is dismissed off the very last ball! Fullish length ball on off, Billings looked to hoick that over mid-wicket. He gets the height but not the distance. It goes straight down the throat of David Warner at wide long on, who takes a good catch. Australia win by 19 runs!
Archer pulls the shorter delivery but just like the last ball, he too finds the fielder, at deep square leg. Just a single.
Pulls again but finds deep mid-wicket. Just the one.
FOUR! One bounce there! Short length delivery, he pulls this uppishly towards deep square leg. It goes into the boundary on a bounce and Billings gets four.
Just the single as this fuller ball is pushed to long on by Archer for a single.

Billings takes the single there! Leg bye called as it came off his shoulder. Short length delivery, he looked to pull at that but misses. It goes off his shoulders to the right of Carey and a leg bye is taken.
He drives this past mid on and takes a single. Will keep strike.
FOUR! With that boundary, England need 29 in 7 balls. Sam moves to the off side and scoops this well over fine leg and bags a boundary.
FOUR! He hit it really hard did Billings! Short length delivery, he pulls this hard to the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
A couple as Billings drags this shortish length delivery from outside off to mid-wicket for a brace.
Looks to pull again but this one kept low. Goes well under the swinging blade through to the keeper.

FOUR! Sam Billings gets to a memorable hundred! Well played! His maiden hundred, coming in his 19th match. He pulls this short length delivery and gets it in the gap at deep square leg region and gets four runs.
Low full toss around the off stump line, just the single as this is stroked to Maxwell at cover. England need 43 from 12 balls.
Yorker length delivery on the leg pole, Archer gives himself some room and works it back to the bowler. Starc fumbles a little and allows a quick single to be stolen.
The physio is out to have a look but Billings seems fine! Change of helmets for him!
Ouch! Pacy short length delivery on top of middle, Sam looks to pull at that but does not connect. It gets the back of his helmet and goes to the off side for a leg bye.
Just another single as Archer works this fuller ball to long on for one run.
Full on leg, Billings moves to the leg side and drives this to long on. Just the one though.
Driven past the covers for a single.

And Billings cannot get it away - neither for a boundary nor a single. Good bowling from Cummins, bowls it slow, wide outside off, within the tramline. Sam throws the kitchen sink at it but does not connect.
Full and in the blockhole on the off stump, Archer just about digs that out to the off side and takes a single. Billings has one ball to face.
Swing and a miss! Fuller this time, kept really low, goes under the swinging blade of Archer to Carey behind.
Play and a miss! Cummins bowls a slower length delivery outside off, Archer swings at it wildly but misses to connect.
Very low full toss outside off, Billings smashes that back to Cummins, who gets a hand but cannot hold on to it. It goes past him and the batters sneak in a single.
Archer drives this past covers and takes one to give Billings the strike.
Length ball down the leg side, Billings looks to make contact but fails to do so. It goes to the keeper for a dot.
Short and in the channel, Sam does not play at that. He is disappointed that he did not play at that!
FOUR! Inventive shot from Billings, he moves to 95 with that. Full on middle and leg, he shuffles across and scoops this fine to the fine leg fence for four runs.
Archer gets off strike, and off the mark as well. Taps this length delivery to the left of Starc and gets to the other end.
This time he gets a single as he drives this straight back past the bowler to long off for one run.
Full and almost in the blockhole, on the off pole, driven, straight to mid off.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. Can he get Billings?
Sam pulls uppishly again, to deep square leg. Just the single this time as he wants to keep strike for the next over.
Pulls the shorter one to deep square leg and gets two.
Jofra Archer walks into the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! In the air...who wants it? Maxwell, again! Excellent cricket this from the Australians! Full length delivery on off, Adil looked to loft that over covers but ends up getting a top edge. It goes high and Maxwell settles well at cover-point. He holds on to it safely as it comes down. Rashid departs for 5.
This time he connects on the pull. Gets it over mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Bowls a slow back of a length delivery outside off which Adil looked to pull but is deceived by the lack of pace on it.
A couple as Adil steers this fuller ball towards third man. His partner equally responds and a couple is taken in the end.
WIDE! Bowls a length delivery way outside off, wide called by the umpire there.
Adil drives this tossed up delivery to mid off for a dot.
Reverse swept again, this time past point. Only the single though.
FOUR! Another reverse sweep, another boundary. Looped up outside off, Sam lets out the reverse sweep, gets it behind square on the off side and bags a boundary.
Adil Rashid walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maxwell's got safe hands, he does not drop these! This is good captaincy from Finch. He brings Zampa in at a crucial stage and Zampa delivers the goods. Loopy ball on off, Woakes looks to go downtown. He though ends up skying it high towards long off. Maxwell, settles himself well and takes a good catch. He has bucket hands, Maxwell.
Reverse swept, but straight to Cummins at deep backward point. Just the single.
Tossed up outside off, Woakes works this over covers but for one only as Maxwell in the deep cuts it off.
A Yorker on middle, Woakes looks to jam it out but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Billings gets through for a single.
A swing and a miss! Outside off, Billings looks to over long on but misses.
A leg bye now! Angled into the pads, it is fuller. Billings looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls to the left of Carey who dives and stops it. A single. Leg bye signalled!
In the air... safe and two! Luck favoring England there! A short ball outside off, Billings looks to drag it but he gets a top edge. It lands safe in the square leg region for two.
FOUR! Not off the middle but a boundary! Very full and on middle, Billings manages to get it past the bowler and the mid on fielder. The outfield is quick and it races away to the fence.
A wild swing there! It was there to be hit though. Slightly fuller and outside off, Billings looks to swing it on the leg side but misses.
Adam floats this on off, worked to square leg for one.
Short ball outside off, Billings punches it to covers.

FOUR! Starc in the deep gets a hand to it but cannot stop that one! Fuller one around off, Sam reverse sweeps to deep point again. Starc dives and looks to keep it out but he is unable to do so. It goes past him and rolls into the boundary for four.
This time though he can only push it back to the bowler.
FOUR! He plays the reverse sweep really really well! He moves to 70 and it is his career best as well! Floats this outside off, Sam reverse sweeps this to third man and gets a boundary.
Flatter ball outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
A couple as he throws his bat to the fuller and wide one. It goes to deep point and the batters take two.
Good length delivery on the stumps, he pushes this back to Marsh.
Comes down again, giving room on the off side. Marsh bowls it full and in the blockhole outside off, Sam looks to get bat on it but fails.
SIX! A long way to go still for England and they need a lot of these! Full on the stumps, Billings advances and lofts this high and over the deep square leg ropes for a six.
This time he opens the face of his bat and works this towards third man for one run.
FOUR! Up and over the extra cover region! Full and outside off, Woakes goes over extra cover for a boundary.
Mitchell Marsh is back in the attack. 3-1-9-0 are his figures.
Powerplay 3 ahs been signalled!
Woakes goes back and pushes this flatter ball to cover-point for a single.
Billings wrists this through mid-wicket for one.
Woakes pushes this fuller ball past mid on for one.
Flicked to mid-wicket by Billings for a single.
FOUR! Billings marshalling his side here! Floated on the pads, he comes down the pitch and lofts this over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.

An appeal for LBW but not entertained! Spinning down the leg side. It lands on middle and leg, spins away down leg, gets the pads of Billings as he looked to play at that. Maxwell appeals loudly but the umpire was not that interested.
Length, on off, Woakes pushes it back to Hazlewood. 3/26 from his 10 overs, what an exceptional bowling spell from Hazlewood!
On off, Chris Woakes keeps it out.
Chris Woakes walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Moeen Ali did the right thing there, looked to go over cover, but does not time it right! England lose another and for Australia, this is another big wicket. Fullish delivery on the off stump line, Moeen looks to drive that uppishly. He does not get the height and it goes straight to Labuschagne at cover who takes it safely. England lose their 6th wicket.
Short length delivery down the leg side, Moeen looks to pull at that but does not make any connection.
On the pads, Sam pushes that towards mid on and completes a run.
Outside off, steered to third man for one.
Lofts this over covers. Lands safely and the batters take a single.
Sam flicks this floated delivery off his pads to square leg for one.
Moeen cuts this square on the off side for a single.

An appeal for LBW, which is not entertained. It was going down leg probably. Flatter ball down the leg side, Moeen comes down the track and looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal from Maxwell follows but to no avail.
Fuller outside off, Moeen defends this out.
On off, driven to cover for a dot.
Glenn Maxwell is back into the attack.
A Single as Ali works this past covers for one.

A single and Sam gets to his fifty. He will be critical to England's fortunes in this chase here! Shortish and on top of middle, Sam looks to pull. He though gets a glove and it goes to the left of Carey, behind. A single taken.
Around off, Sam pushes it back to the bowler.
Full on off, worked to the fielder at cover.
Moeen wrists this down the leg side and takes one.
On middle, Moeen gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it out.
Josh Hazlewood to replace Starc from the other end. He has bowled 8 overs, conceded 21 and picked up w wickets.
Loopy ball around off and middle, Ali pushes this towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Ali goes back and pushes this flatter ball to the on side for a dot.
On off, worked towards third man for a single.
Sam Billings leans forward and works this past covers for two.
Moeen Ali walks into the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Bairstow slams that high in the air towards deep mid-wicket! Has he got enough on it? No! That's a brilliant catch by Hazlewood in the deep there! Slower in the air on off, Bairstow looked to monster that over deep mid-wicket for a six. He gets it high in the air but does not get the distance. Hazlewood, running to his right from long, judges the ball, dives forward and takes it safely. Bairstow, who was going well, has to go back to the dressing room now. Also, is that game over for England? A lot was dependent on him. Probably he should have taken Zampa on here. It was the longer side and with the breeze blowing against that side, wrong idea.
Adam flights this outside off, Sam drives that to long off for a single.
Starc is seen limping. The skipper does have a word with him but Starc continues to stay on the field but he does signal to the dressing room.
A good bumper to end! On the body, Bairstow ducks under it. Carey does really well to dive to his left and stop it. Three dots to end but still 11 from the over.
A short one, does not have the same zip as Starc usually has. It is left alone.
Excellent fielding from Starc! A low full toss on middle, it is driven towards the right of the bowler who dives and stops it. Starc is struggling with his left leg here.
SIX! That has been deposited into the stand! Shorter and around middle, Bairstow stays back and pulls it a long way into the square leg stand. It is the shorter side and with the breeze.
A single now! Good batting. Fuller again and on middle, this is worked wide of mid on for one.

FOUR! Welcome, welcome boundary for England and for Billings! Lovely. That one is straight as an arrow. It is full and on middle, Billings creams it past the bowler and down to the long on fence. Good start to the over, they need to make it count now.
Just a single as Sam picks the fielder at deep square leg with the sweep. He can only take a single here.
Flights this on off, Sam comes down the track but plays it back to Adam.
Flighted outside off, Sam pushes this to the off side.
Bairstow pushes this towards cover and collects one.

A very stifled appeal for LBW! Flatter ball on the stumps, Bairstow looked to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the top of his pads. It was too high nad maybe going down the leg side as well.

FOUR! Jonny Bairstow makes use of the field and places this to perfection. There was just the one fielder in the deep square leg region. Bairstow sweeps and places it well to the right of that fielder and gets a boundary.
Adam Zampa to bowl now. He has figures of 2/26 from his 6 overs.
On a length around off, Sam looked to guide that towards third man but fails to get any connection there.
Got away with a full toss there, Starc! Sam can only drive this towards Maxwell at cover. Billings too was cramped for room there as it was very close to his body.
Way too full on the off stump, Sam digs it out to mid on.
Bairstow drives but finds sweeper cover. Just the single.
Back of a length on middle, gets the top of Bairstow's pads and goes to the off side and he looked to turn that to the leg side. A dot.
On middle, kept away to mid-wicket for a dot.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. He has bowled 5 overs for 17 and is yet to pick up a wicket.
Good running again and a couple. Billings cuts this shortish length delivery past point for two.
Back of a length delivery on top of the off pole, Sam defends it back on to the pitch.
Athletic running and a couple. Sam pushes this shorter ball towards fine leg and takes two.
On a length on top of middle, Sam keeps it out towards short mid-wicket.
Shorter ball on the pads, flicked away on the leg side for one run.
Opens the face of the bat to guide the length ball towards third man for a single.

DRINKS! Australia would be mighty pleased with the way they have bowled overall but this partnership seems to be a thorn in their flesh, something that they cannot seem to shake off. They tried their best, but somehow the pair has fended off all challenges. The visitors will hope that this break dents the momentum that this pair have achieved so far while England would want these two to continue going. This partnership is key for the hosts, in order to stay in the hunt. Let's find out which way play goes after the break.
Inside edge saves Bairstow! Length and around off, it comes back in. JB looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
One more single! Angled into the pads, Billings looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the leg side for one.

FOUR! That is nowhere off the middle but races away! Shortish and on middle, Billings stays back and looks to pull. It comes off the lower part of the bat. Labuschagne runs to his left from deep mid-wicket and dives but fails to stop it.

Had Marsh picked it up cleanly, it could have been close. It is angled into the pads, Billings works it to the left of mid-wicket. Bairstow comes a long way down the wicket but is sent back. Luckily for Bairstow Marsh fails to collect it.
Length again and on off, Billings stays back and defends it onto the ground.
Good length and around off, this is guided towards point.
FOUR! Width in the channel outside off, Bairstow cuts that fine behind square on the off side and gets a boundary. A good over for England, 9 runs off it.
And again, swivels and looks to pull but this kept low as well. Misses yet again.
Misses! Bairstow swivels in his crease and looked to pull the shorter one. It kept low though and hence he missed.
Sam guides this length delivery to third man for a single.
On the pads, flicked away to fine leg for a single.

In the air but dropped, but it would not matter as it was a free hit anyway. But clumsy work from Australia this, a no ball, free hit and then a drop. Bairstow powers this over square leg but does not get the elevation. It goes to the deep where the fielder comes running forward but spills the supposed catch. A couple collected.
NO BALL! It was way too short as well! No ball has been called by the third umpire for overstepping. Bairstow lets this short ball be. Free hit to follow then!
Marcus Stoinis will bowl now. He will be the 7th bowler to bowl for the visitors today.
BEATEN! Good length delivery around off, Sam looks to defend off the front foot but misses it altogether.
A single to follow the maximum as this is worked past point for one.
SIX! Make that three sixes for Jonny Bairstow! Full and on middle, he short arm jabs this one over wide long on for a biggie.
On middle, Sam tucks this towards square leg for a single.
Jonny Bairstow gets out of the pull midway. Gets hit near his shoulder and the ball goes to the off side after the deflection. A leg bye collected.
Length ball around off, Bairstow looked to guide that towards third man but misses that one.
Good over for England, 8 off it. This is nudged towards deep square leg for one run.
Flighted on the pads, Sam tucks this towards square leg and gets to the other end.
Slower through the air outside off, worked to short third man for a single.
Flatter ball on the stumps, Billings works this uppishly towards square leg for one.
On middle, Jonny pushes this on the leg side for one.
Jonny works this flatter ball to fine leg and bags a couple.
Glenn Maxwell to bowl now.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Bairstow does not play at that. Wide called.
Glenn Maxwell to bowl now.
SIX! Similar ball, similar shot, but this time, it goes high and over the fine leg ropes for a maximum.

FOUR! Again, in the air, but well over Carey! The boundary bring down the pressure as well! Short length ball, Billings looks to pull but gets a top edge which just about goes over Carey and into the fine leg fence.
Defends the length ball back on to the pitch.
BEATEN! Now, Cummins, angles one in just outside off, on a length. Sam looks to play it but misses that one.
FOUR! Just wide of mid off though! Full, a little bit too full, outside off, Billings drives that uppishly and just a bit wide, to the left of mid off and the ball manages to go to the boundary.
On a length outside off, steered to short third man for a single.
Pat Cummins is back in the attack. Can he get a wicket?
No run.
A huge, huge shout! Billings comes down the track and Marsh bowls this on a length outside off. SB looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and goes towards the keeper. Outside the line of off.
Billings is struggling. He has not got used to the pace of the wicket. It is a length ball around off, Billings looks to pull but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller and on middle, Bairstow strokes it towards mid on for one.

That is brilliant running from Bairstow. Some urgency shown by him in the last few overs. Also fifty for him. His 13th in ODIs. He holds the key for his side. He has not been at his fluent best but is hanging in there. It is also the slowest fifty by him in international cricket. Needs to continue. On middle, this is worked towards backward square leg for two.
That one comes back in nicely! Length and on middle, this one jags back in. Bairstow looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Billings looks to sweep but does not get bat on ball. It gets him on his body and falls back on the track.
Shorter one, pulled away to the leg side for one.
He looks to be targeting this over, Bairstow. Plays this uppishly towards square leg, the fielder in the deep gets to it and keeps this down to a couple.
SIX! It is a flatter one! Slower in the air on the stumps, Bairstow launches this over cow corner for six.

Ohh...How has that missed the stumps? It was agonizingly close! Zampa tosses this around off, it does not spin and goes on straight. Bairstow looked to sweep but does not connect. It goes to the keeper without disturbing the woodwork behind. The Aussies have their hands on their heads there.
SIX! Ohh..he finds a short one to his liking and punishes that! Short and on off, he goes back and pulls this firmly over deep square leg for a biggie.
A dot to finish as Sam works this length delivery to short third man. He was interested in a run but not Bairstow.
Full and on middle and leg, Jonny flicks this towards Zampa at fine leg and takes a single.
On the pads, closes the face of the bat to flick this to Zampa at fine leg for a brace.
Billings works this fuller ball through the carpet to mid on and takes one.
Bairstow is down the pitch, works this towards deep square leg and gets to the other end.
On a length outside off, guided towards third man for a single.
Bairstow defends this out off the front foot.
Connects the sweep this time, to square leg. A single taken.

Australia appeal, once again, for a LBW. The umpire was not interested though and Finch, he is frustrated. To review or not is a conundrum and he decides not to review that. Zampa tosses this on middle and leg, Sam looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. A loud appeal follows but to no avail. Interesting, had Finch reviewed that!
Another couple as this is swept away to fine leg for two.
In the air for a short moment, Maxwell does well at cover to stop the momentum. Billings comes down the track and works this past Maxwell at cover for a couple.
Tosses this on middle, kept out to the off side.
Angled into the pads, Billings looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken. Just the one from the over. Run rate needed above 8 now.
Length and on off, Billings guides it to point.
Inside edge! Fuller and on middle, Billings looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Angled into the pads, Billings works it to mid-wicket.
Length again on off, blocked.
Back of a length and on middle, it is defended.
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack now.
A single as this is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
Billings prods forward and keeps this out.
On the shorter side, Billings goes back and keeps this out of harm's way.
Billings dances down the track to this tossed up delivery but pushes it straight to mid off.
Billings presents the full face of his bat and defends this out.

NOT OUT! Finch was very hesitant to take the review earlier, he though a bit this time too, but takes it in the end and ends up losing the review. Flatter ball down the leg side, Sam looked to turn that down the leg side but misses and gets hit on his pads. Australia appeal but the umpire stood still. Finch ponders and takes it upstairs but Ball Tracker says that it was going down the leg side. Tough luck for Finch!

Finch takes the review this time! It is for a LBW against Sam Billings. UltraEdge comes in and no bat involved. Ball Tracker states that it was pitching outside off, the impact was in line but the ball was missing the stumps. So, Australia lose the review!
Shorter ball, Bairstow comes back for the second as he pulls this to Steven Smith at deep mid-wicket.
Sam jumps and drives this length ball to behind square on the off side for a single.
Back of a length delivery on top of the stumps, Sam defends it back onto the ground.
Full and on the pads, flicked away to deep square leg for one.
This time he tucks it to square leg and gets to the other end quickly.
On a length around off, Billings keeps it out to the off side.
Gets behind the line of the ball and keeps it out.
Bairstow sweeps but finds short fine leg. A dot.

A huge appeal for LBW from Australia but Bairstow was outside the line of off. Tossed up around off, Bairstow prods forward and looks to defend but misses and gets rapped on his pads. Australia appeal but the umpire was not convinced. Finch, well, he decides not to review that and it was a wise decision.
Sam moves to his left and right, his trademark style of play. He comes down and pushes this fuller ball to long off for one.
The reverse sweep is out! Bairstow does not time it well though. It goes to Starc at short third man and a single is taken.
Adam loops this in the blockhole on the leg pole, Jonny just about digs it out.
A single to finish as Jonny cuts this past point for one.
A couple this time! Bairstow looks to pull the shorter one but gets it off the toe edge. It goes to square leg and the batters take a couple.
Misses! Bairstow looks to give room and cut that behind square on the off side but misses to connect, primarily due to the bounce.
Full on middle, driven to mid on for a dot.
Length ball outside off this time, Jonny drives on the up but finds cover.
Length ball on top of leg, Bairstow keeps it out to mid on.
Mitchell Starc is back in the attack. His figures read 3-0-9-0.
On off, blocked.

A strong appeal from the Aussies for a LBW but there seemed to be an inside edge there. That is why Finch did not opt for the review as well. Adam loops this on middle, Sam prods forward and blocks that. He and the keeper appeal strongly but the umpire is unmoved. There was an inside edge there and hence the Aussies do not press any further.
Billings rocks back and works this flatter ball towards short third man.
Looped up outside off, Jonny works this past covers for a single.
Bairstow pulls the shorter one but finds short mid-wicket.
Sam Billings walks out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Labuschagne takes an excellent catch! It was difficult, especially under the floodlights, but he keeps his eyes on the ball, steadies himself and takes an excellent catch, diving forward as the ball dipped on him. Zampa floats this around off, Buttler launches on to it. He gets the height but not the distance. It goes towards Marnus at long on who takes it brilliantly. Huge wicket as Buttler was one batter who could have easily turned the game around.
Shortish in length and outside off, Bairstow fails to time it properly. He ends up chopping it on the off side.
Another delivery on a length around off, Buttler opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one. He is off the mark.
Length and on middle, Buttler shuffles across and pushes it back to the bowler.
Length and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Length and on middle, Bairstow defends it onto the ground.
That is a beauty! Hazlewood continues to trouble the batsman. Length and around off, this one comes back in. It cuts Bairstow in half as he looks to put bat on ball. It goes over the stumps.
Buttler drives this fuller ball but straight to cover.
Jos Buttler walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A wicket for Australia at a critical juncture. Maxwell has bucket like hands and he holds on to it safely. Flatter ball on the off stump line, Morgan rocks back and looked to play it over mid-wicket. He though gets it uppishly but just to the left of Maxwell at short mid-wicket. Maxwell lunges to his left and takes that catch. He is elated and so is Zampa, they know how big a wicket this is.
Short and outside off, punched to cover for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Loopy ball on the pads, Bairstow looked to trickle that down the leg side but he cannot get bat on it. It gets the top of his thigh pad and goes down to fine leg for a boundary off extras.
Floats this outside off, Bairstow is not interested in playing at that.
Saw Morgan coming down early and bowls a flatter one, the England skipper looked to work that towards square leg but misses. It goes off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
WIDE! Floated down the leg side, Morgan lets it be. Wided.
Adam Zampa to bowl now.
On the pads, turned down to mid-wicket for a couple.
A single as Morgan flicks this full ball to square leg for one.
Looks to pull the shorter ball, Morgan. Misses and gets it on the top of his pads.
SIX! And that has gone all the way! Full and well outside off, Morgan comes down and slaps that over covers for a maximum.
Bairstow works this towards mid on and takes a quick single.
FOUR! That should give him some confidence, Bairstow! Fullish and outside off, he cuts that hard, past point, for a boundary.
Morgan lofts this fuller ball in the air over covers. It lands safely in no man's land there and a couple is taken.
Good challenging bowling from Cummins here. Another bouncer, this time just outside off, Morgan sways away, yet again.
In the channel outside off, a bumper, Morgan sways away from the line.
Looks to pull but misses. The ball goes behind square on the leg side off the top of his pads. A leg bye is taken.
Bairstow drives well but finds the man at mid on. Stoinis it is there. He is having a really difficult time here, Jonny Bairstow.
Misfield! Full on the off pole, Morgan strokes to to Warner at cover, who misfields. The ball goes past him and the batters sneak in three.
On off, driven to mid off for a dot.

Excellent bowling from Hazlewood! Pitches on off and nips back in sharply, Bairstow looks to block but misses and the ball goes past and through to the keeper. There was a sound as the ball passed Bairstow and hence Carey appeals for a catch but the umpire does not feel so. He is interested in taking a review but Finch rubs it off.
Jonny swivels and looks to pull but is into the shot early. Does not connect. Gets hit on his body.
Length ball outside off, Jonny steers this to cover-point for a dot. He seems frustrated with the dot balls here.
Fullish on off, drives uppishly but safely. It goes on the bounce to Maxwell at mid off.
Good length ball around off, Jonny defends it back on the track.
Swivels and pulls from within the crease. The ball goes to deep square leg for one.
On a length around off, Jonny defends to the off side for a dot.
Bairstow defends this out to the off side.
BEATEN! Good length delivery around off, Jonny looked to block at that but the ball goes past his outside edge.
A single as this is worked past the point fielder for one.
FOUR! Short length delivery on top of the stumps, Morgan pulls that away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 signalled! A maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over now.

NOT OUT! Good review taken by Jonny Bairstow! Full and on middle and leg, Bairstow looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Australia appeal and umpire Richard concurs, raises his finger. Bairstow has a chat with his skipper and takes the review almost instantly. And he reverses it in his favour as the ball was going down the leg side. Bairstow stays!

Review  time! Bairstow wants to review the on-field LBW decision against him. UltraEdge comes in and there is clear daylight between bat and ball. What does Ball Tracker say then? MISSING THE STUMPS! Review retained by England!
Bairstow defends that off the front foot.
Looks to pull the shorter one but does not connect. Gets hit on his shoulders and the ball rolls away to the off side.
Oooh! That just about went over the off stump. Good length delivery on top of off, Bairstow decides to leave it. Australia let out oohs and aaahs as it went over the top to Carey.
Looks to drive Bairstow but the ball comes off the inner half. It goes towards short fine leg and the batters take a couple.
Full on off, swinging in, Bairstow does well to keep it out. That delivery looked a bit threatening there, as had Bairstow missed he could have been bowled or been plumb LBW.
Full and around off, Bairstow looks to defend but gets it off his outer half towards third man for one.
Follows the boundary with a single as he guides this length delivery towards third man for one.
FOUR! Lovely shot from Morgan, straight through the ground. Overpitched on off, he strokes this past mid off and bags a boundary.
Back of a length delivery way outside off, Morgan looks to defend from within the line as the ball goes past by.
Good length delivery just outside off, blocked to mid off.
Fuller on off, Morgan strokes this towards mid on and follows it up with a loud no.
Length on off, defended back on to the pitch.
Good length ball around the fourth stump line, Bairstow reads it carefully and lets it through.
On a length on top of off, Bairstow blocks.
Morgan gets off the mark as he works this towards cover and runs quickly to the other end. Warner throws it at the non-stiker's end but it was very wayward.
Good length delivery outside off, Morgan defends that out to the off side.
Eoin Morgan, the English skipper, walks in to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Got Root this time! Terrific stuff from Hazlewood and Australia! Length delivery around off, Root hangs his bat out, looking to defend. He though gets an outside edge. The ball goes low to Carey who dives forward, grabs it and does well to hold on. England lose their second and are in trouble here.
A dot to end another excellent over! On off, it is defended.
Back of a length and on off, Bairstow stays back and keeps it out.
Shorter and on middle, Root pulls it through square leg. Not time but a single taken.
On a length again, Root keeps it out solidly.
Good length and on off, defended. This is excellent from Australia. Giving nothing away.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Back of a length delivery around the off pole, Joe defends this out towards point.
On middle, Root blocks this towards cover.
Pat Cummins to bowl now.
Length ball around off, Root looks to defend but fails to get bat on ball.
Root drives it back past Hazlewood but the mid on fielder runs in and cuts it off. Root wanted a single but is sent back by Jonny.
BEATEN! Some oohs and aaahs from the Australian players there! On a length just outside off, Root looked to defend but the ball goes past his outside edge to the keeper.
Outside off, Root leaves it alone.
On middle, tucked to square leg for a dot.
Good bouncer from Starc, on top of the stumps. Bairstow ducks well to duck under it.
Drives again but this time, Maxwell, at point, puts in a good dive and interceps that. A dot.
FOUR! That should ease the pressure a little bit for England. Full and outside off, Bairstow creams this through covers for a boundary.
BEATEN! The wind also seems to be working in favour of the fielding side here. Length and around off, Bairstow looks to play at it but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Bairstow keeps this length ball out towards short mid-wicket.
Length ball on top of off, Root blocks it out.
Joe Root walks in at No.3 for England.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a catch from Hazlewood! He had little time to react there, but sticks his hand out and grabs that one safely! Full length delivery on middle, Jason looked to drive that back past the bowler but he ends up hitting it low and uppish back to Hazlewood, who displays amazing reflexes as he grabs that one. Excellent bowling from Hazlewood and excellent, quick reaction there. Great start for England and not a good return into the side for Roy.
This time he decided to play it safe. Defends it from within the crease.
Length delivery around middle, nips back in after pitching. Jason comes down the pitch and looks to play at that. He though misses and the ball goes past him to the keeper.
This time he looks to drive on the up and connects, but straight to the fielder at point.
In the channel outside off, Jason looks to half cut at it but misses altogether.
On off, defensively pushed towards short cover for a dot. Good over for Australia and Starc there.
Bairstow looks to pull the shorter ball but fails to connect there. Good pace and bounce from Starc!
On a length on top of middle, tucked to the leg side for a dot.

Good running and the batsmen come back for three. Short length delivery, Jason looks to pull but does not time it that well. It still goes through mid-wicket and three collected as the ball is sent back in.

Around off, Bairstow drives to mid off and takes a quick single. Roy gets in safely as Warner throws it to the striker's end and hits. But Roy was well in there. The batters decide against taking anything on the overthrows as the ball deflected towards square leg after hitting the stumps. Just the single then.
Play and a miss! Full and well outside off, Bairstow looks to drive on the up but misses altogether.
First runs off the bat! Bairstow is off the mark with a single as he taps this fuller ball to Warner at mid off and gets to the other end.
Good length ball on off, Bairstow strokes this to mid off.
Full on the stumps, this is defensively worked to mid on.
Excellent bowling from Hazlewood there! It pitches on off and nips back in a touch. Bairstow looked to drive at that but the inswing does him in. It goes past his blade to the keeper behind.
On a length around off, Bairstow shoulders arms.
Back of a length around off, Jonny defends, to point.
WIDE! Hazlewood starts off with a wayward one outside off. Wided by the umpire.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end.
A maiden to start from Starc. Roy strokes this fuller ball straight to mid off for a dot.
WIDE! Bowls a length delivery down the leg side, Roy looked to flick that but does not connect. Wide called.
BEATEN! Starc expects it to move back in but the ball is not swinging, so far! He bowls this full and well outside off, Roy looks to drive but misses completely.
Short and wide, outside off, Roy looks to cut but he missed out there.
Full around off, Jason drives but finds mid off.
BEATEN! Not going to be easy upfront to play Starc! Full length delivery just outside off, Roy looks to defend but misses.
Starts off with a full length delivery way outside off, Jason Roy lets that one through. A bit of a loosener from Starc.
We are back for the chase! Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow are the openers for England. Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings with the first new ball. Here we go...
